SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — NOT PNW POLICY

ING 25000 — Synthetic Ingestion Systems

Prerequisite and corequisite relationships

Complete either both ING 11000 with a minimum grade of C and ING 12000 with a minimum grade of B, or ING 13000 with a minimum grade of C.

The corequisite is ING 25001 and it may be taken concurrently.

This published relationship does not determine a student's personal eligibility.
